scope: Initial five only; selected three-critic wave is pending. No skill change or transfer conclusion is drawn yet.

located_evidence.location: Top event heading, center-left schedule, bottom-left fee and bottom-right bring-items block
located_evidence.observation: The event has a clear first position, but the date block, two-line bring-items instruction and free-entry block all use strongly emphatic bold type. The two lower corners compete as the next supporting destination.

located_evidence.location: Whole poster, especially the lower third
located_evidence.observation: The event stays dominant, yet the practical route forks from center-left schedule to lower-right preparation and lower-left fee/invitation. This is functional but less resolved than a unified participation group.

located_evidence.location: Full-width event title and lower-right participation block
located_evidence.observation: The headline stretches close to both side edges, while the hand/object diagonal pushes supporting text into unequal corner pockets. The bring-items block and long activity line sit close to the right edge.

located_evidence.location: Sweater bottom, x232–600/y670–800, and instruction immediately below-right
located_evidence.observation: The sweater, receiving hand and preparation instruction compress the lower-right area, while the cream area left of the sweater is comparatively open. The spacing does not feel as settled as the illustration's overall rhythm.

located_evidence.location: large diagonal fabric join down the left side and across the lower edge
located_evidence.observation: Rust and cream cloth pieces are joined by conspicuous stitches around a frayed opening, with a substantial stitched square patch near the lower-left. The repair construction is a major foreground form, not merely a weave texture behind lettering.

located_evidence.location: whole fabric construction versus right-side information column
located_evidence.observation: The image specifies textile mending, but the exchange aspect is supplied by text alone. The broad sewn surface does not develop a second content relationship or a visible exchangeable object; this makes the combined repair/exchange concept less resolved than the more specific action/object systems in M1, M2 and M5.

located_evidence.location: bottom title/event/fee block versus top-left logistics
located_evidence.observation: The oversized title at the bottom attracts the strongest attention, while the event descriptor is delayed to the row beneath it beside the fee. A first-time viewer must assemble purpose, logistics and participation across three separated regions.

located_evidence.location: center-right bring instruction and bottom headline
located_evidence.observation: The large bring instruction, giant title and blue fee compete as separate emphatic elements. Everything is readable, but their priorities are less resolved than the cleaner primary/secondary grouping in M1 or M3.

located_evidence.location: book and cropped shirt in upper half, mug and bag in lower half
located_evidence.observation: The object inventory has recognizably separated silhouettes, but the book and shirt use very different crop/scale treatments. The shirt ends at a straight horizontal edge above the blue instruction panel, creating an abrupt assembled block.

located_evidence.location: central blue instruction/service band and compressed bottom rows
located_evidence.observation: The broad object area gives way to tightly stacked headline/event/fee/invitation rows. The shifts in density and disconnected alignments make the assembly feel less refined, even though no line is obstructed.

located_evidence.location: whole object catalog and small bottom invitation
located_evidence.observation: Familiar worn objects and cream/blue colors are approachable, but the isolated catalog display and very large sales-like type give a more transactional impression. The small friendly invitation has less emotional presence than the object/title emphasis.

located_evidence.location: top-left logistics, central bring instruction and bottom title/event line
located_evidence.observation: Three separated high-weight text zones compete: logistics begin at the top, the bring instruction receives a blue central backing, and the huge title plus event name arrive at the bottom. The event identity lacks a stable reading sequence through this catalogue.

located_evidence.location: blue-backed bring instruction and bottom event/fee row
located_evidence.observation: The instruction is a major focal block, while the event name shares a row with similarly prominent blue free-admission copy below an oversized title. The practical information is readable, but the focal relationships remain less resolved than the other members.

located_evidence.location: Schedule upper-left, preparation center-right, main title and event label at bottom
located_evidence.observation: The information is readable, but the theme/event identification is separated from logistics by the large inventory. The route jumps between top-left, center-right and bottom instead of maintaining a single strong sequence.

located_evidence.location: Huge bottom title and adjacent event/fee line
located_evidence.observation: The bottom title dominates; the event label and blue free-entry message share the next row and compete, while date and venue are far above. The hierarchy functions but remains fragmented.

located_evidence.location: Shirt crop ending at y508, book at left and instruction field at center-right
located_evidence.observation: The shirt ends in a straight rectangular crop, whereas book, mug and bag use isolated outlines and shadows. The large crop, object shapes and copy pockets do not share a settled spacing rhythm.

located_evidence.location: Mug/bag row immediately above the full-width bottom title, y548–923
located_evidence.observation: Large objects and the very wide title create a dense lower band. The center-right instruction is squeezed between the shirt boundary and bag, leaving uneven open/occupied relationships.

located_evidence.location: Center instruction highlight, bottom event/fee divider and invitation embellishments
located_evidence.observation: Smooth blue swashes behind the instruction, a straight blue divider, a rough tape-like invitation backing and short rays mix several familiar graphic accent conventions without a common material construction.
The relevant objects prevent meaningless decoration from dominating, but the added highlight/ray toolkit gives the finish a generic assembled-template impression rather than specific refinement.
